name: Sentience
source:
Sentience is a game following a little girl who is trapped in her bedroom, she want's to get out, will you help her?

[From [url=https://ilyaislin.itch.io/sentiencegamejam]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Sentience》講述一個被困在臥室裡的小女孩的故事。她想出去，你願意幫幫她嗎？
